description: Jeu de données GTFS du 1er septembre 2025 au 31 mai 2026 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Transdev Vierzon Mobilités • Le Vib. Coverage: Transdev Vierzon Mobilités • Le Vib. The publisher named on the listing is Transdev Vierzon Mobilités • Le Vib. Its keywords include transport-urbain, horaires-bus, localisation-geographique, mobilite, reseau-de-transports. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2025-10-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
